name: Silvered Chains of Vael
effect: Roll 2 defense dice. When defending against a Chaos Warrior, roll 1 additional defense die. Does not halve movement.
flavorText: The tarnished silver links were forged in a monastery the Chaos legions burned, and the metal has not forgotten.
heroRestriction: Barbarian, Dwarf, Elf, Knight, Warlock, Berserker
